# <span id="aanchor91"></span> Import Lab Analysis

If you do not have the Source Analysis module, you can use the Import Lab Analysis screen to import gas analysis sample data that uses Quorum's text file format.

The text file must be in the FLOWCAL lab analysis import format.

FLOWCAL will read the gas analysis sample contained in the text file, apply the gas sample to the meter and re-calculate volume and energy values as applicable. This process is often used to apply spot and/or composite samples received from a lab.

<div class="procedure">

To import a lab analysis file:

1.  Go to **Import** \> **Lab Analysis**.

2.  Click **Browse Files** to locate a text file to import (example: C:\data\01301-July.txt), or type the file path into the **File Name** field.

3.  Specify an alternate file name if applicable. (See: [Alternate File Format](Lab%20Analysis%20Import%20Format.md#Alternate))

4.  Select **Specify Start Time** and **Specify End Time** to override the start time and end time in the analysis import file (if applicable). The import file end time is effective until the next calendar month, unless another analysis exists with a start time later than the first.

    If not overridden, the start and end dates will be the dates specified in the import file. If this option is used, it is recommended that both dates be overridden.

    <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Start End Formats">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Start Time and End Time Formats</a>

    <div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Start End Formats">

    Three date and time formats are available when specifying start and end times:

    - For a specific date and time, use **mm/dd/yyyy hh:mi:ss**.\*
    - For a specific date with an implied time for the meter contract hour, use **mm/dd/yyyy**.\*
    - For a specific month and year with an implied date for the meter contract day and an implied time for the meter contract hour, use **mm/yyyy**.

    \*These formats are used most frequently.

    </div>

5.  Select **Force Recalc** to force a recalculation of the meter data with the analysis (if applicable).

6.  Select a recalculation method (Recalculate Volumes or Recalculate VCFs) from the drop-down list.

7.  Click **Import**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 359;height: 189;" />

</div>

Windows has a hard-coded limit of 260 characters for file paths; file paths longer than this will not work. Importing files from a local install allows for using drive letters for network file paths; however, Citrix resolves the actual network location, which can cause the number of characters in a file path to exceed this limit.
